content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"yes","applies_why":"This judge text labels D6 vs C4 UNDERDETERMINED because paternity has no explicit textual resolution.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D6 vs C4 (Romans 1:3): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] section A.1-2 and [CR3] Link 6 premises 1-3, where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.","room":"The phrase 'a single verse does not state a link or its contrary' — read narrowly as only bare verse-silence, versus read broadly as any lack of explicit textual resolution.","why":"Because it assigns UNDERDETERMINED on the ground that paternity lacks explicit textual resolution, it does what K-S2 forbids."}
